comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer onto roller slides while keeping rear hooks clear, then pull-test it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load carrying, controlled vertical clearance, slide engagement, lowering, and retention testing.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer correctly engages both slides/hooks and survives the specified pull check without dropping or mis-seating.
comparison.reason: This tests large-object bimanual alignment and latching into slides. The candidate tests fine rotary/tool manipulation and a separate controlled impact sequence.
